string.value: It is here that the battle for our island begins. Dominate our enemies by holding the Command Points. The bar at the top of your screen shows you whether we are winning this fight, or losing it.
Dennis has marked the Command Points with flares. Stay close to these flares and the point will be ours.
The more warriors fighting at your side, the faster you will capture a Point.
When capturing a Command Point, a circle in the middle of the screen will display your progress. Be warned. So long as an enemy contests an area, you cannot win the point.
Welcome to Domination on Beachhead, a paradise marred by war.
And these, my warriors, are the Cages.

Holding the Fort will make us stronger.

These are the Containers, make them ours.
This is the shanty. Stay alert here.
As you know, there are several transmitters scattered across the region. It is time we spread our message to our lost sisters and brothers.
When a transmitter is ready, you must take it before our enemies can. Even if you fail, you will have two minutes to steal it back and spread the voice of our people.

When a transmitter heats up, Dennis says it will boost the signal, broadcasting our message to the farthest reaches of this island. Whoever has the transmitter when this happens scores twice as many points for their side, until the transmitter overheats and goes silent.
Welcome, noble warriors, to Transmission on Beachhead.
This is Transmission on Homestead, a battle that is important to all of us.
This is Transmission on Fishing Village.
Here is Transmission on Jungle, we are at home in our fight.
Now we fight for Transmission on Sub Pen.
The ancestors demand that we win Transmission on Temple.

It is here that we must rise up. Protect what is ours and deprive the enemy of what is theirs. Two supply depots belong to us and two to them. We must burn their supplies while protecting our own. If the ancestors are smiling and you ignite both our enemy's depots at the same time, you will give birth to a cleansing firestorm. Doing this will activate an emergency radio.
If the firestorm is our doing, we must reach the radio first, wait for a signal and call in our allies. Only then will we win.
If the ENEMY has started the Firestorm, we must reach the radio, wait for the signal and call in our allies to kill the fire. This will reset the match.
Warriors, welcome to Firestorm on Mudslide.
This is Firestorm on Fishing Village, fight with pride.
Welcome to Firestorm on Jungle, fight like warriors.
This is Firestorm on Boatyard, don't fear the flames.
The cleansing flames of Firestorm come to the Sub Pen.
A Firestorm will rage in our beloved Temple.
Here, we must show that we are willing to kill more of them then they could ever kill of us. The bar at the top of the screen will tell you how the fight is going… in our favor or theirs.

Killing an enemy warrior adds a point to your tribe's score, pushing the bar in your favor. But remember, a tribe fights together or dies alone, so revive your fellow warriors! Each such revival will rob a point from the enemy.
Kill to win Team Deathmatch on Beachhead.
Victory for Team Deathmatch on Hideout.
To Team Deathmatch on Homestead, my warriors.
This is Team Deathmatch on Mudslide.
You now fight in Team Deathmatch on Fishing Village.
Hold your ground in Team Deathmatch on Jungle.
Kill or be killed in Team Deathmatch on Boatyard.
This is Team Deathmatch on Sub Pen.
Fight to the end in Team Deathmatch on Temple.
Kill all enemies in Team Deathmatch on Shipwreck.
Welcome to Domination on Beachhead, a paradise marred by war.
And these, my warriors, are the Cages.

The more teammates who got your back, the faster you capture a Point. Do it alone, you fucking asshole, when you're sitting there holding your dick while your teammates live and die without you. Okay?

So, listen good, hermano. We’ve got several transmitters out there, and I want you on those things so we can get all nice and coordinated.

When a transmitter is ready, you and your teammates better jump on that shit and take it before anyone else does. Good news for you? If you fuck up and lose the transmitter, you got two minutes to steal it back.

Now these transmitters, these pieces of Russian Cold War era shit, they will break on your fucking ass. They'll heat up, boosting the signal, right? So guess what? Bonus time. You control a transmitter during that, you rack up double points… 'Til those fuckers blow up and then go dark. But then again, that's fucking life.

I love that word... Firestorm. It's made me the fucker I am. The thing is... the enemy has two supply depots. We have two supply depots. Burn theirs down while keeping what’s yours safe. Simple right? Now here's my favorite part. Torch both enemy depots at the same time, and you trigger a -- say it with me -- Firestorm! During this Firestorm, you gotta fight for control over the newly-activated radio.
If you started the Firestorm, first off, good for you hermano. Get to the radio first, wait for a signal and call in air support. That is how you win.
If the other guys started the Firestorm, get to that fucking radio, wait for a signal and then call in air support before all our shit burns up! That’ll reset the match.
Congratulations, everyone, for Firestorm on Homestead!

So long, history. It’s Firestorm on Temple.

So listen up fuckers - This is simple: Kill. You and your teammates need to kill more of their guys than they can of our guys. Simple war mathematics, right? The bar at the top of your screen shows you who's ahead. Do not fuck this up.

Popping a member of the opposite team will add a point to your team's score, and push that lovely bar in your favor. Now don't leave your teammates hanging like a fucking bitch. Revive those motherfuckers. Each revival removes a point from the enemy's score. Let's get it done.

Hey Liza, get me one with pepperoni!
Hey, check this out! Looks like somebody's house!
They don't care about keeping shit clean around here. Before he died, he probably prayed for a satellite dish.
Hey! Check this out! Watch this.
Yeah, he's not coming to my pilot ceremony next month. Shocker, right?
Dude, you know your brother's always doing his own shit, right? Don't worry about it.
Hey, hey I thought Doug said there weren't people on the island. Guys.
He's not coming to my pilot ceremony next month.
Dude, you know your brother's always doing his own shit, right?
Hey, hey I thought Doug said there weren't people on the island.
You are awake. Well, not all of you. The arm has been deadened to allow for the tatau.
What did you do to me?
It is brave to swim in a storm, but to sunbathe on a beach with pirates? Insanity.
You have the right to take my life, but know I will also take yours.
Bangau, Labah-labah. The heron, the shark and the spider.
I know who you are, Jason. You are a warrior. And the tatau will allow for you to reveal your true self.
Listen. My older brother has been killed. I need to find my younger brother and four other friends.
No, you can only help yourself. I am going to free you.
I found you on the beach.
Welcome to Amanaki Village. It is something, isn't it, huh?
Selamat tengahari[Good afternoon]. I have Jason Brody with me. The man who escaped Vaas's camp alive!
Your escape is a sign that the battle has turned. Our people are in need of good news.
The island calls to the strongest. It called to me. The island dwellers, the Rakyat, accepted. And I became a member of their tribe.
The island calls to the strongest. It called to me. The island dwellers, the Rakyat, accepted. And I became a member of their tribe.
I could have any one I choose. But my will is set on one woman.
Enough talk, you must learn the ways of the island if you are going to survive.
You want to save your brother, right?
What do they say in America? There is a first time for everything.
Don't I need some kind of background check?
That is much better than a knife! Any time you need weapons, visit a store. That make sense?
Be patient. If you go after your friends now, you will never survive. You must first become a warrior.
Every night the warriors go deep into the jungle.
I hear there are others who live there and were never captured. Who still know the old ways.
Here, the power comes from the Jungle, from the Island. You must learn the terrain. Know where to stand at all times.
Vaas uses the towers to map the island and to locate his men. Scramblers block access. Our people have no use for devices such as these, but you, you will learn valuable information from them.
So taking out the scramblers will help find my friends?
Yes! The scramblers are at the top. Each tower covers a limited area. Climb them all and you will reveal the entire map.
That must be the radio tower.
Not getting back down that way.

You see? Everything you need to know has been revealed by the radio tower. Shops, adventures, the island calls to you. And, like you, Jason, the shopkeepers are from the outside. They will use the radio towers to do business and reward you with weapons for every tower you free.
A true warrior must hunt. It is the natural order of things. Look at the map, select your hunting ground. Do not fear your instincts. Society has taught you how to fail, not nature.

Now. If you want to save your friends, you must know the jungle. Animals skins and leather will allow you to carry many weapons and equipment. Plants can be mixed to create potent medicines that heal you, enhance your senses and more.
Go. Return to me once you have mastered the jungle.
What does that mean? What am I supposed to do?
My instincts. Okay. What are they telling me?
Bring back plants and animals. But which ones?
It's like something brought me here.
There's this voice inside me telling me where to go.
All right. You can do this.
Dennis. I killed an animal. What now?
You have taken a life from the island, do not waste it.
Dennis. I've got the plants and animals.
Then bend nature to your will. I will teach you.
Everything carries the power of the Rakyat.

The plants you harvest can be combined in syringes to help you. Pay close attention to the colors. Green will heal you. Red will help you to fight. Amber aids with hunting. And blue will make the world come into focus.
Do you see? You can make medicine.
Now, use the plants you found to craft two syringes.
You may even find more powerful plants out in the woods, if you are lucky.
Now, use the skins of the animals you killed to enlarge what you can carry.
Crafting will allow you to carry more weapons, money, loot and syringes.
Yes! One last thing. The tatau on your arm, it is a sign that you are special, that you have the soul of a warrior. You progressed along the path. Let me show you how to add to them.
With each tatau, a skill is mastered. You can choose to learn skills in three different areas.
Now, I will teach you the takedown.
As you become stronger, with each new skill you learn, the tatau will grow. Choose another.
Hey Felipe. We're driving to the outpost near Amanaki. We have one of the Americans. Come have some fun.
We have to get her back!
Can't this thing go any faster?
You are eager. That is good.
What's this outpost they've taken Liza to?
The outposts are strongholds found throughout Rook Island. Vaas's pirates hold them to control the surrounding area.
So we're heading into a fight.

Yes, a worthwhile one. Rescuing your friend will kill two pigs with one stone. We are at war with Vaas. Taking outposts from the pirates is key to reclaiming the island. We conquer one for the Rakyat, the area becomes safer. This means faster travel for everyone, and new opportunities to develop your skills as a warrior.
Rakyat warriors. The true Rakyat, who live at the heart of the island. The tatau will help them trust you.
Look, I appreciate your help, but I just want to save Liza and find my friends. And my brother.
This is the only way to get them back alive. [beat]You escaped the slave camp. You survived. It is time to fight.
We are all equal, Jason. The difference lies in those who do not act. That is the difference.
Like you, I was once a stranger here. You are not alone, my friend.
We will wait for you to begin the attack.
Jason. Dennis has given you the tatau. Now you must fight.
Prove yourself. We will help you.
You can attack them quickly, pick them off from a distance, or sneak in. It is your choice.
Everything's going to be okay Liza!
They're all gone, you're safe now!
The outpost near Amanaki is under attack. Where is the American prisoner?
She escaped on the west side of the fucking island. I'll tell you about it when we get there.
Jason. You are worthy of the tatau.
Worthy to walk the Path of the Warrior.
I think I'm going to be sick.
We found one of your friends at the colonist's house.
Doctor Earnhardt to the west. But do not worry, it is safe there. The Doctor will be waiting for you.
To the West? Did he tell you which friend?
No. But we will keep continuing our search for the others. I will radio you if we hear more. Keep your head up Jason. The tribe is very impressed with you.
I gotta send a message to the outside.
It's not sending. I bet the island only has a local network.

I'm on my own now. [beat] I'm so sorry, this is all my fault. [beat] But I'll fix it, I'll make it right. I'll find Riley. I'll bring him home. I'll bring them all home. I'm the only one who can do it.

I'm on my own now. I tried calling for help, but I can`t reach anyone outside of the island. [beat] I'm so sorry, this is all my fault. [beat] But I'll fix it, I'll make it right. I'll find Riley. I'll bring him home. I'll bring them all home. I'm the only one who can do it.
The honor is ours, white one. I hear you come from across the seas. Give us news of our Native American cousins. Are they still dancing with the wolves?
I'm just fucking with you. We are isolated, but we're not THAT isolated.
Jason! I almost forgot. While you are with the doctor, make sure to ask him to give you recipes for medicine. He has uncovered some very powerful ones.
Always remember to listen to the jungle. It'll make you stronger, faster. It will take you off the beaten path. Let it and you will be rewarded.
See anything you fancy? I like the red ones myself. The purples will give you a lift on a grey day. Everything is excellent, really.
Oh, not the yellows, don't take them, they're liable to kill you. The mix is not quite right yet. Well, that said, Dr. Earnhardt here. Or, in and out, as the case may be.
Yeah, I'm Jason. Dennis said you'd be able to help me. That you'd found one of my friends.
One of your "friends?" Ha… I'm distilling a batch later today.
Oh, you... you mean the girl, Daisy?
I assumed you to be speaking in code.
Why, she's in my house, sir. Here.
I have been administering to her every hour. Don't worry. I'm more than able to multitask.

Yes. Of course. When I found her she had cut her arm, which in itself would be no cause for alarm but she had cut through a field of Antiaris toxicaria. Upas trees, highly poisonous latex. I have been administering an antidote each hour.
I am afraid that another dosage may be required. I did just examine the box.
It's empty. Where should I go for more?
Set us up with a couple cave mushrooms, and we will be right as rain. Peruse the cliffs to the west.
Thank you, Doctor. I'm sorry for the rush.
Think nothing of it. The girl must live. For you and me both.
Great. He didn't mention the cave was UNDERWATER.
This crazy doctor better know what he's doing.
I like the red ones myself.
You are awake. Well, not all of you.
The jungle speaks only through the warrior. The Path leads to the heart of the jungle.
The studio called...I got the role!
Yeah! I was super nervous on the phone.
But I'm starting in three days.
What about the rest of our vacation?
[sighs]I thought we could talk about this like grown ups.
Liza. We're in Bangkok, together, and I can't believe how beautiful you are.
Sh, sh, sh, sh, shhh. Do you want me to split you two like I did your friends?
I promised Dad I'd take care of you both.
Riley's your little brother. He looks up to you.
Hey J, you're gonna come to my pilot ceremony next month, right?
You mean, heading to Oliver's cabin in Tahoe to ski? Yeah, I'll trade you.
What are you afraid of? You're a natural with a gun.
Nothing can stop us! We'll take on death.
Woah. How long was I down there?
Finally. I hope it's not too late.
Oh, Jason, what a pleasant surprise. I whipped up a couple of high notes since you were gone. Oh yes, and the girl is now awake. Terrible fever however.
What did I do with the buggers?
Oh yes, I finished them off.
Delightful. Give them to me. I need a couple of minutes to prepare the medicine. Go check on her.
You got away. That's how I'm feeling.
Oh he's, he's harmless. He's kind of sweet, actually. He carried me here. I escaped from the convoy. At some point I passed out. The doctor saved me. Yeah...
I'm glad you made it. It's been really rough.
Are you going to be okay? I've got to talk to the doctor about the others.
Whoever did this. Whoever killed Grant. He deserves to die.
I want to thank you for saving her.
Three of my friends and my little brother are missing. When I find them, can I bring them here?
Absolutely not. I cannot afford to have Vaas's captives here. His men buy product from me todo el tiempo.
Then this is the safest place. He won't think to look for them here.
Please, doctor. Let him bring the rest here. They'll die otherwise.
Agnes! How can I refuse you? Of course, they can stay.
Oh, I'm going to need a double dosage to calm my nerves.
Wait here, all right? I'm going to find the others.
Jason! Did you find your friend?
Yeah, yeah. She's fine. Thank you, Dennis.
You made this happen. Not me. It is your victory.
Where are the others? Is there a way I can search for them? Anything to help me find them?
You know, Jason, the pirates use a satellite dish for communication on the Medusa. You could enter the com room and listen in on the signal.
A ship that has been beached nearby.
The Path of the Warrior, Jason. Train your body and your mind will follow. The tatau will bring you closer.
Liza and I used to go hang gliding all the time. Now I'm doing it alone.
This place has got to be crawling with pirates. I need to find a look out.
Okay...now what about the other side.
I'm ready. It's now or never.
Okay, Jason. Time to take out those pirates
[tuning sound]...A shipment to Hoyt's pens in the morning for processing and another left for market at end of day.
Vaas is recording ransom videos at P.C.
He's ransoming them? I was told to line up buyers.
Do it. After the money from the parents shows up, the kids go on the black market and we deliver them to buyers.
Hey! Can the chatter! Someone triggered an alarm at the Medusa, you morons.
We're closest. I can see it right now.
Hey Dennis. I hit the Medusa. Now, the pirates sent a message--
Jason. Vaas wants us dead. There is no time to talk, come to Amanaki Village, we need your help.
Vaas prepares to attack our village. He is gathering weapons even as we speak now.
My friends are in trouble too.
They've been taken to somewhere called P.C. Vaas is going to ransom them and then sell them anyway.
This is good then. You have time.
Jason, please. Fight for us. The Rakyat will be murdered. If you can sabotage the weapons, it'll weaken Vaas. And he'll be easier to kill.
Ah! I knew we could count on you.

The pirates stock weapons in the logging camp in the jungle. Shut off the alarm first, okay? If it is triggered they will secure the weapons shed. Steal the explosives, then destroy the weapons. You got that?
How many people has Vaas hurt? How many more will he hurt if someone doesn't stop him?
Here's the camp. Now for the alarm.
Wow, they've got a freakin' arsenal in here!
Don't let him get the weapons!
Don't let him get to the second shed!
Protect the last shed at all costs!
All right, time to call it in.
Hey Dennis. The pirates won't be attacking anytime soon.
Jason! A fine piece of work. Now, tell me about your friends.
The radio said Vaas was recording ransom videos at P.C.
P.C.? P.C...Pirate's Cove. But we call it Sunset Cove. That's one of their prisons.
To get in, find the key. The overseer will have it.
Remember, Jason, the strength you receive from the Path will help you succeed.
Hey. It's Daisy. I borrowed the Doctor's phone. How's the search going?
I'm getting closer. How are you?
Good. [beat]The doctor moved me to this cave under his house. It's safer, since the pirates come to buy from him all the time. But get this. I found something down here. You have to see it.
Okay. I'll meet you there later. Hopefully, with our friends.
I've got the find the overseer.
Now where're the ransom videos being shot?
When the boat arrives, move the slaves from the hold to the showers.
Remember. Only a little oatmeal per captive. We want them weak.
Thirty seconds per meal then you take the bowl away. Refill it. Give it to the next in line.
Sort out the pretty ones and inject them with drugs.
Make sure the men are beaten if they try to resist.
It's a video. She's not here.
I want you to say, "Mom, Dad…"
That's very nice. I want you to do it again.
With more emotion. You can do it, honey, come on.
Yo, Vaas. The Brody boy's just raped the comm room at the Medusa, man he's f--
Benjamin, Benny, Ben. I'm directing this film right now, ok?
You need to get outta here, man. Those fucking idiot cocks mentioned your name on the radio--
Could you please stop swearing? OK? We are in the presence of a lady actress.
Fuck me? Did you see what you just did? You just turned my actress against me. Now get the fuck out of here. Disappear.
I wanna apologize for my friend and his complete lack of tact, okay? This guy's a complete asshole.
We're gonna win the Oscar for this, okay?
What did your mother tell you about swearing?
Wait. Wait! We're worth ransom money.

Who give you that ink, hmm? I asked you a question: who give you that ink, hmm? Citra give you that ink? My sister give you that ink, huh? You think that makes you one of us? You think that makes you like me, huh? California boy has got a hard-on for jungle fever. I'm gonna drive a bullet through my sisters' skull. Like I did your brother Grant.

You are angry, Jason. You are angry. OK, I get that, I get it. I mean without family, who the fuck are we? There was a time where I would do anything for my sister, you know? First time I ever killed was for my sister. But that was not enough for her. No, no, no, no, no, please.
You see the thing about our loved ones, right? Our fucking loved ones, they come and they blindside you every fucking time.
So they say to me, they say, "Vaas! Vaas! Who the fuck is it going to be? Them or me? Me or them?
Like, you know, like they fucking think that I need to make a fucking choice!
By the way, this lighter really sucks. You know, so much for poetics.
It's really too bad that Citra had to ink you up. Because now the only way to kill you is to erase you completely.
Shhhhh... It's OK. Don't cry. It's OK.
Jason, I swear to God, man. It's truly beautiful that you are willing to die for the one you love... Let’s give these lovers some privacy.
No! No! Jason! Jason! No! No...
Stay calm. I'll think of something.
Not that way! Definitely not that way!
I need to put out those flames!
I can't believe there's running water in this place.
I've got to shoot the pipes.
Oh no! This place is coming down!
I can't take any more of this heat.
Liza, I can see the door. I'm coming!
Jason! Where are you? Help me!
Don't worry, I'm here. Stay still.
Oh my God, they took Oliver! They took Oliver!
We can't do anything about him now.
Okay, go! I have an idea.
OK. Oh! Oh, no. I can't do this.
It's the only way down. Come on.
I can't believe we just did that.
You jumped out of a plane a couple days ago.
What are you doing? Come on!
We've gotta get out of here!
Okay, okay okay! Oh, get in!
Wow. Did you see that explosion?!
I can't do this. How am I supposed to handle this?
What are you doing? You're shooting at them, Jason.
Drive straight! You're making me miss!
How can I focus with them shooting at me?
Hands at ten and two! Ten and two!
They're coming up behind us, Jason!
Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god.
Why did you turn off the truck?
I don't... What does that even mean?
Faster, faster! Hell yeah, those motherfuckers never knew what hit them.
You think almost being killed or sold into slavery is "fun"?!
OK, listen. I'm fixing this. Do you know where the pirates took the others?
They took Oliver to some place called The Bunker. I'm not sure about Keith or Daisy.
I don't know anything about Riley or Grant.
Oh Jason. Oh, I'm so sorry.
But I found Daisy. I'll find the others.
A safe place. I'll take you there.

Isn't she beautiful? Turbina Corymbosa. I brought her over from Mexico. The seeds produce an addictive high somewhat akin to LSD, but it is the flowers that I so love. While under the influence of hypnotics and "psychotics", white is an essential experience. What fascinates me is how something so pure can turn the brain to the brink of destruction. And yet we consume it... like moths to a flame.
Charming. You can bunk with my little Agnes, my dear.
Oh, that sounds great. I love children. Where is she?

She died when she was very young. We were having the windows to our flat replaced and wouldn't you know, she fell out and down, down, down. Of course, there was no choice but to leave London. I had to leave and so... I sailed away, and came here.
Well, I must return to my harvesting. Oh, your friend is in the grotto.
Daisy told me she's in a cave under the house.
Look, I'm done crying. But I found this boat. If we can repair it, we have our ticket off the island.
Yeah and straight to the bottom of the ocean.
Says the boat expert. But I do need some help. There's a power head for the outboard motor. It's missing.
Okay, I'll take a look around.
You really think this boat will work?
I grew up with boats. It will, trust me.
I don't want to talk about it.
I wonder what's going on in Santa Monica right now?
Traffic to Malibu. That's what's going on. You're not missing anything.
Hey, you found it. And since you're carrying it... You can hook it up.
Tell me again why you aren't doing this?
Yes! Great! We can take it from here.
You might want to check in with Liza before you go.
Every night I dream I'm in Hollywood and then I wake up here.
I'm sorry you missed your shoot.
It's not your fault. I should have insisted we skip skydiving. The important thing is we're both safe.
But you saved me. I'm here because of you.
What we need now is an action plan.
OK. I find Riley and our other friends, you stay here and help Daisy with the boat.
We nearly didn't make that escape.
Liza, I've got this. Don't worry.
Where'd you learn how to fix a boat?
Dad taught me on Deer Island. I almost went into sailboat racing. But then my brother won the America's Cup. So, swimming it was.
You should see our trophy room. Craziness aside, my races bring us together, so, I'm happy.
Jason. I have tried to reach you many times. What happened?
Vaas captured me. I made it out with Liza, but he still has the others. I'm not strong enough to get them out.
You need the power to defeat Vaas. I cannot provide such strength. But, there is someone who can. Citra. You are ready. You must go to her.
Citra is the leader of our people. She can guide you to the center. She will reveal your true power. Her temple is in the jungle. I will meet you at the gates.
What have I gotten myself into?
Jason! Stand still. In plain view. No sudden moves, okay?
A young Warrior, here to be presented to Citra.
Dennis! You brought an outsider in here!
I have found one who will not fail.
This is Jason, the one I have been telling you about.
Do they teach you to speak without permission in America?
No, I learned that in France.
You are brave to joke in the face of death.
Fine work. I'll give it back to you after I cut it off!
Very few outsiders have seen this temple. The inner courtyards, fewer still.
I need the strength to defeat Vaas and save my friends.
Is that all? I will not command my army for you. You are a lamb. Not one of us.
Well, then I will become a warrior.
And I will do anything to get him back.
Bring me what has been lost, and we'll talk.
Yes, Citra saw the fire in you.
What did she mean? Bring her "what has been lost?"
Drink and you will find an answer.
You are speaking out of fear. Do you desire the power to save your friends?
We spend our whole lives holding back. Imagine how quickly you can succeed if you just take what you want.
Oh fuck. Oh fuck. Oh no, no, no, no, no!
You going to steal from me, kid? Save your friends?
They're mine now, but I'm a generous man. I'll split them down the middle. Fifty fifty.
You want to work for me, kid, you have to follow my rules.
Vaas stepped up to the table. So will you. We are killers, three of a kind.
My boy, you'll find out soon enough.
Around here mate, you eat what you kill.
This terrain is second nature to me.
I'll take you bloody if you like, I like my meat rare.
This is some fucked up foreplay, huh?
You are so close to the end. come on! End it!
I saw my friend, and my little brother Riley... And then I followed a man in a white suit. I saw a shantytown, a bar. It was dark and dingy. And, uh...
An ancient knife with a decorated blade. How did you know?
There is a shantytown to the east in pirate territory.
Okay. Then that's where I'm headed.
Oh, but the town is big. How are you going to find a knife?
Simple, I'll start with the man in white.
This town. It's the one from my dream. Doesn't seem to be doing too well.
I've got to find the man in white.
I heard we're getting a new shipment of smokes from Hoyt.
I've been hearing that for weeks. Do you see any smokes? No.
It's the guy from my dream!
Did you hear about Snow White?
Shut up about Snow White. Every time you tell this story, we're playing.
What the hell are you talking about?
Snow White escapes from Vaas's prison camp. Next thing you know, he's killing guys with a machete.
Awwww, that's the worst version of the story I ever heard. You ruined the drama.
Sounds like Hoyt needs to step in...if it's true.
Hoyt would make quick work of the guy, that's for sure. Probably kill him with his own machete.
He already did with the owner of the mine. Hoyt's an artist, he'll kill this one special.
What you say he looked like again?
That's the guy from my vision. He's going to lead me to Keith and Oliver.
Did he spot me? No... no, we're good.
I gotta keep up with him.
That man's the key to this. I know it!
You have that info about your johns?
I wrote it out. It's not that often that I get to hold a pen. So much for English school.
Keep it together old man. Nothing out there but ghosts.
What...? Gotta cut down on the caffeine.
You have ten seconds to tell me who you are before I remotely detonate the C4 under the table and this whole place explodes like a pop bottle.
Yes...or no? Which one gets me blown up?

[Continuing without answering Jason] Promising, but do you consider yourself a patriot, Mr. Brody? Thing is, the real patriot doesn't just put his hand on his heart while holding a hot dog at the ball game. That's a gosh darn cakewalk, pardon my French. The real patriot suckles at the teat of Lady Liberty. Upon hearing of the death of a brother at war, the real patriot asks "Did we win?" and then rejoices at the pronouncement of victory. So are you a real patriot, or one of those Walt Whitman hippies who cries when the jeans store runs out of pocket squares?
Bingo! That's what I like to hear. By the way, Vaas has your friend Oliver Carswell, and I’m zeroing in on Keith Ramsay.
It's my job to know this island inside and out. I can help you, but you gotta play the game. There's something I'm looking for. We'll trade favors.
What are you? Some kind of spy?
I'm not gonna confirm or deny that. [smiles]Just messing with ya. I work for Langley. Agent Willis Huntley.
Oh great. I need to get help from the army and the government.
You can't. I'm embedded, not really in contact with Central Intelligence.

No, you kidding? I've got a whole team. They're out in the field, but they'll be back. These scans they sent have opened up a Grade-A can of worms. I can't talk to you about it, but trust me, it's big.
I need more info though, from the source.
Flammenwerfer. Flamethrower, this beauty was invented in Krautland.

Hoyt Volker is the boss of a very good friend of yours: Vaas. He also happens to run the largest slave trading ring in the South Pacific. On top of that, he grows drugs. If we set fire to his fields and his boat, he's gonna canoe over to this island. I get what I want and we learn more about your friends. Kapeesh? I feel like that's only an Italian thing, only Italians can say that. It's like spraying furniture gold. You know what I mean? Anyway, here's the gun.
That's what I like to hear. Don't forget the boat.
Yeah, I got it. I'm trusting you on this thing with Hoyt.
I'll play ball as long as it gets me closer to finding my friends.
Maybe Dennis knows more about Hoyt.
The vision led me to the man in white. Turns out he's a spy or something.
Funny. I've never heard of such a man here on the island.
He told me about Vaas's boss, Hoyt.
Hoyt Volker. Stay away from him, Jason. You think Vaas is crazy. All the evil on the island, it comes from Hoyt. He took Vaas's mind away from him, it is he who pulls the strings.
DARE to keep kids off drugs.
Mrs. Appleton would be so proud of me right now.
Gotta take out the boat now.
Burn, baby, burn -- burn that mama down! [Disco Inferno stanza]
That's number three... man I love this thing!
And number four goes up in smoke!
Number five was totally worth it.
Now to blow up that boat....
Shit, I'm running dry. Maybe the pirates got a stash lying around.
That's it! I am outta here!
Those Germans, what can I say, they know how to light stuff on fire. Got you an earpiece.
Thanks. Hey, you ever go out on recon with your guys?

Nah, nah, nah. There's a reason I have the American flag in here. In here, there's society. There's order. Out there, the jungle. The synapses in our brains go dark little by little. You forget where you're from, who you are.
Yeah. So...what about my friend, Oliver?
I've almost burst this thing wide open, I can feel it. By the way, you're getting popular.
Why, boss, you planning a parade?
That's why I love you, Vaas, you make me laugh. Everything in business is so goddamn serious. But you. So, uh... what about Snow White?
You know what, I do not give a fuck about him. I don't give a fuck.
Really? Then why am I here?

Foster, Jason Brody, whatever your name is, it's slipped my mind. How stupid do you think I am? We should keep playing. Dealer's on the left, right?
Guess he's sitting this one out.
So, caught your little reunion with Riley. It brought a tear to my eye. And I'm rarely moved. But, I'll admit, I underestimated you. Torturing your own brother. Destroying half my organization.
But let the chips fall where they may, right? I forgive you.
So, name your price. Everybody has one. You're all puppets and we pull the strings. The system was designed to work that way.
I don't think I can let you fold. I've got too much respect for you, Jason.
You know what, Jason? I'm going to go easy on you, since you're a family man. One finger every time you lose.
What do I get if I win?
I think I'll start with... the ring finger.
Aw, Jason, now we'll never be married. You know, you could have joined me. Every kill would have been rewarded with money.
I take no pleasure in this, really I don't.
I don't need ten fingers to use a knife.
I've been doing this long before you were born, kid.
I'm very disappointed in you, Jason. You haven't checked up on your little brother, Riley.
Don't worry, I sold him to someone very special in Yemen. He likes them young.
I have very powerful friends who will hunt you down.
They won't find anything left of you.
You can't win. I hold all the cards.
Your brother's at the airstrip. Don't want to miss that plane.
Those brands on your arm. They own you.
That woman is playing for keeps.
Hoyt, I have a present for you.
Let me give you my knife. Free of charge.
Riley. Gotta get to the airstrip. Now.
Shit. I don't need this right now.
I have to get to my brother.
Not good. I gotta get outta here.
This just keeps getting better and better.
I can't do this on foot.
I gotta get to the airfield!
Jason, where are you? They're taking everyone, I don’t know where. We need your help!
Get over here as fast as you can!
No, uh-uh, bullshit. It's scam. You run if you want, I'm staying.
I've been with Hoyt for seven years now. He's not gone, it's a test. See who's loyal and shit. I'm not moving.
That German guy? That motherfucker scares me.
Hoyt didn't scare you? Huh... fuck that.
Riley must be in one of these buildings.
Hey! Where's Riley Brody? Where is he?
I didn't know if you were gonna come!
We have to get out of here. Follow me.
I thought I'd never see you again.
Don't worry. I'm not leaving this time.
Hang back. I'll clear us a path to the chopper.
God, you look so different, like a warrior. Pass me a gun. I can handle it.
Yeah, I got that for a plane!
Well, now's the time to learn.
How do I do this? How do I do this? Ok...Ok... uh... shit!
Just focus on getting up in the air. I'll do the rest.
Riley, I'll cover you from out here.
Uh, I'm going to need more than a few minutes here. Hey, hey, they're talking about us on the radio. It sounds like they're coming here. What do we do?
Just focus on getting up in the air.
I'm stuck on something! Top of the tower, Jason!
Riley. Hold the helicopter still. I'm going to shoot you free.
Are you kidding? I'm way, way past worried, J!
I bet if I shoot these fuel buildings, they'll explode.
There goes your four wheel drive!
I--I think I'm getting the hang of it! Are you okay?
Oh shit... oh my God, oooh my God! Oh, we're gonna fuckin die man! This-this is it, we're gonna die!
Ok... ok... what... whoa... whoa-- I don't know what to do with this, man!
Oh, thanks. You want, you wanna try! Oh shit... oh shit..
On the road, on the road!
Uh, uh, bad dudes at the fuel pump!
No, no, no! They've got choppers!
They've got trucks with machine guns.
Oh God, oh God, oh God!
Oh man. We barely made it.
You're handling this like a pro.
Yeah, well, I learn from the best.
Keep heading in that direction as fast as you can!
Keep heading in that direction. The others are waiting for us.
Okay. All right. I can - I can do that... Yeah!
Yeah! Okay. Oh, this is so cool!
She came to see me but I couldn't save her. I tried to halt them.
Yes. It must be wonderful to look at the world through your eyes. Innocent like a child. Alone. Like me.
Where are they? Where are my friends?
Agnes, look at me. This is your father, the culprit. Let your love turn to hate and burn me like the surface of the sun.
Burn me like white fire. Never forgive me. Erase me.
I couldn't halt the jungle warriors. I'm sorry. They carried your friends... to the... temple.
The great warrior who killed Hoyt has returned.
Do not worry, I am helping you. This is the final step on the path, the final test, and then we will be together. Do you not trust me?
They are here. With me. Your family misses you. I miss you. Come home.
I don't understand. I need to get to the temple.
Riley. We have to go. Now.
Everything's fallen apart. I really messed up.
Grant. None of this would have happened if I hadn't brought us to the island. You should be here, not me.
Hey, c'mon, we're in this together, all right? We'll get out together. We're brothers.
I'm going to talk to Citra. This has to be a misunderstanding.
Rakyat! When I came to you, I was an outsider. When I came to you, my body was bare. My scars a roadmap of foolish things.
Rakyat! You gave me a roof. You gave me food from the earth, water from the lakes. You gave me hope! You covered my scars with tatau and turned shame into strength.
Citra, what have you done with my friends?
He'll be fine. Come, follow me.
I appreciate everything we've had together, but... I am leaving with my friends. We're going home.

Look at you. Big, strong, powerful. Why would you want to go back to what you were? Now, you are perfect. It is my fault. I let you live with all these burdens. The Path purified you, but the cleansing is not complete.
I love you, Jason. But you do not let me give you all my love.
I know how hard this must be. It hurts me to watch you in pain.
I only want to help you. To love you for who you are. To worship the man you have become. It will all be over soon. I will lead you onto the dais and you will be free of your past.
Walk the Path of the Warrior.
With the Rakyat you are powerful, like those who came before you.
Knives take people away, they don't bring them back.
Some warrior you are. I bet you shot Vaas in the back.
You coward. Don't point that knife at me.
They will all fall at your feet.
And you're carrying all these weapons and you have all these weird tattoos.
Where were you when Grant was dying? You ran away, didn't you?
You think you're a warrior? Because you collected those tattoos on your arm?
I could never love you. You're just a child.
I am yours. We all are.
Powerful warrior, you deserve the final tatau.
You think almost being killed or sold into slavery is fun?
Think you're so tough? You tortured your little brother. That's disgusting.
You're living in a fantasy world. I'm going to erase all of it.
You brought us to this island. You killed Grant. It's your fault.
You are ready, Warrior. Here is your blade.
Complete the path, or all your progress, your tatau, everything you have done on this island will be erased.
This violence is over. I'm done. No more blood.

Jason, why must you leave? You will stop being a warrior, a hero. Your friends, they will move on, have kids and boring lives. Stay here. The Jungle will always be there for you, and you will always be King. With them gone, you never have to leave.
Jason. Look at me. Stay with me. You don't need any of them. You are powerful on your own.
You must keep going. Complete the path.
Jason, what is wrong with you? Citra, she saved me, she saved all of us. And you reject her love? Argh!
What have I done... what have I done... Citra... Citra, please, do not leave me please... Citra, I am sorry, Citra, please don't--don't leave me...
I'm so sorry, Citra! I am so sorry!
Come on, Riley. We're going home.
I've killed so many people I've lost count. I can't come back from this. I'm a monster. I can feel the anger inside me. [beat]But I am still, somewhere inside me, more than that. Better than that.

We've been prisoners most of our lives. Slaves of people like Vaas, Hoyt...Citra. Trapped by money and other drugs. Chasing fun, running from fear. Not any more. This world may not be perfect, or rewarding most of the time, but there are people we love who are counting on us. Who need us. So free yourself. Turn it off, rise up and the ones in charge, the ones who have taken you prisoner, will fall. And this world will be yours. Game over.

Hey. I guess I missed you. I can't really talk for long. I have to pick Riley up from school and take him to flight training. He just got his license, you should have seen the ceremony. The kid was beaming. And, uh...I think I might have that job at the studio. Not sure yet, but fingers crossed. [beat] The thing is, I miss you. And I know you can't forgive me. But I believe that we have more to say to each other. I'm not giving up. Liza. Call me.
No. Jas! Please! Please... please, Jason! No! No, please!
We have a new hero living among us. Jason! He has walked the Path. He is the ultimate warrior.
The Rakyat will be reborn. The ultimate warrior has given himself in the place of the coward Vaas. Cinta untuk anak-anak kami. Let his spirit be released for the future of our people.
You are perfection. The ultimate of your kind. And our child will lead the Rakyat.
Shhh. Rage against the darkness. You are a warrior. Die a warrior.

Ah, memories. Memories, they last a lifetime. But the thing is about times is? Times change and shit gets old and buried really fast. I hear people say all the time, all the time--family is priceless, family is priceless. No, no, no, no, please...that is fucking bullshit. Family is an anchor when you are, the fucking Titanic.
Man, I think I got the wrong guy. I’m looking for Jason. Is he, like, there? Is Jason in the vicinity?
Hurk, man. Jason’s never met me, but I need some help, if he’s interested. Sending you my location. You let him know, okay?
Hey...I'm Jason. You looking for me?
Is that short for Hercules, or something?
No, man. My parents were pacifists. Oh shit!
Oh no no no! I lost Coco, man. You made me lose Coco.
Coco! Macaque monkey? About yay big? Wears a vest with about a pound of C4 strapped to him.
You strapped C4 to a monkey?

Navy did it with dolphins. Russians did it with dogs back in WWII...though they fucked up. Didn't have German panzers to train them on. They taught the first batch to run under their own tanks...That's funny huh?
So you did that to a monkey?
Oh, well...I was hoping Coco could do my dirty work, but, uh... that was a bust, huh?. Guess I have to defuse this.
No, defuse Coco. If he blows up around them other monkeys, it'll scar them little dudes.

Vaya con dios, little buddy. No! Wait...there he is. Oh, man...He must've taken that vest off. That is awesome! Whoa...So...I definitely got work for you. Yeah, the pirates got their hands on some Bowa-Seko conflict diamonds, but our rebel buddies need them more, right?
Sure. The Rakyat could sell them for supplies.
Yeah, I already sent Snowflake and Bubbles II after them, but they're MIA.
So I need you to sneak in that old temple and snag them diamonds, ok?
Good luck man! Those monkeys were smart and they didn't make it back! Come here Coco, come on!
This guy needs all the help he can get.
Hurk's diamonds should be in here.
Gotta be careful, can't alert the pirates. Bet they’ll send reinforcements.
I bet there are a couple ways in.
Can't be seen. I don't want reinforcements.
What about Snowflake or Bubbles II? Did you see 'em?
Yes, I’m fine, thank you. Not a scratch on me.
No, I said, did you find my chimps?

I think there's interference or something, dude. If you can hear me, drop the diamonds off at the cache and grab the reward I got stashed there. Remember, man...you're on the honor system. I'm trusting you with my stuff.
Jason, it's Hurk, man. Remember me?
You're hard to forget. What's up?
Haha. I got three dudes, totally went dark side and defected from the Rakyat.
What? Dude, no. Three of Citra's warriors switched sides and went over to Hoyt's camp. The warriors are shitting puppies, man. They want these dudes shut up before they tell tales, right?
Dudes are holed up in a boat repair yard, man. I'm sending you the deets. Oh, and Dennis wants pictures of their bodies.
I don't care if they switched sides, I want guards on them.
If these pussies change their minds, I'll kill them myself.
Make sure the defectors stay put. We got questions for them.
Awesome, man! The warriors are gonna be stoked. They'll let me in for sure, now.
What d'you mean, let you in?
Can't talk. Gotta go. On my way to see them now. Later alligator.
[Whispering] Jason? Yo, it's Hurk. Remember me?
Stop asking me that. And why are you whispering?
I was transporting supplies to the warriors, but I got boarded by Privateers. Man, they saw the pictures you took...they are not happy right now, okay? I’m hiding out, but...you gotta save me, dude.
I’m on my barge...so, like...on a river? Sending you my coordinates now.
[Distant-Mouth away from the Receiver]Oh, hey dudes. What's up? Don't kill me, okay?
Hurk? [beat]Hopefully he's smart enough to stay alive until I get there. I give it a 50-50 chance.
I've got to clear out the privateers before looking for Hurk.
I bet they're keeping Hurk on his barge.
Dude! You did great, man, you did awesome. But, um, we got an “issue”, okay?
The privateers wanted to drive this thing right into the rebel camp and blow shit up there like a Trojan horse, man, Michael Bay-styles!

Yeah, you did, you did, you stopped 'em, but uh... Thing is, they was picking up more bad dudes along the way to hide in the barge. So we are headed into wall-to-wall testosterone and guns waiting to go all aggro on us.
Ok, I'll defend the boat while you steer.
Coo…uuuh… Thing is, Big Sally here, she acts up under pressure sometimes. I think it’s a performance anxiety thing. So I might have to, y'know, fix her.
[sighs] Okay. I’ll shoot and you…you, you keep Big Sally afloat.
Cool, man! This is going to be epic, man! The tat brothers in action, yeah!
C'mon Big Sally, not now! [Yelling] I'm on it!
C'mon Big Sally, not now! [Yelling] I'm on it!
Fixing Big Sally... you keep shooting.
Fixing Big Sally... you keep shooting.
You're gonna stop these next dudes, right?
You're gonna stop these next dudes, right?
They're shooting RPGs at Big Sally, man! Do something!
They're shooting RPGs at Big Sally, man! Do something!
Dude! The chopper is back and it brought a friend! So not cool, man.
Dude! The chopper is back and it brought a friend! So not cool, man.
The choppers are back! Man, I KNEW they seen us!
The choppers are back! Man, I KNEW they seen us!
Take them out before they Sushi us!
Take them out before they Sushi us!
I can't steer while they're chewing up Big Sally!
I can't steer while they're chewing up Big Sally!
You kill them snipers yet? Cause I'm steering blind here.
You kill them snipers yet? Cause I'm steering blind here.
I'm going down there to help them!
Dude, that was awesome, man. Saving me, that shipment...the rebels are jazzed.
Why you gotta be like that?
At least I hugged the little dudes before I— before I—
No! Shut up! I'm not...Just… give me a minute here.
'All right… It's all right, Tat Bro!
Ok. About that? What is with that?
What, "Tat Bro"? Oh, I figured, uh, once the rebels see how much I've helped you, they'll ink me up like you.
So that's why you're doing all this?
Oh, and Citra's 100 percent MILF, man... Malaysian I would like to fuck? Come on, man, put in good word for me?

Awesome! Awesome, yes! 'Cause I am working on something big, man. But I I need your help, like mondo, okay? So go chill, do whatever it is, put yourself in a state of chill, okay? Then come back when you're ready to do this, okay? Don't come until you're ready, man! Okay? Don't forget me, bro! Take it ease!
You are awesome! I got this thing the rebels are going to F-U-C-K love. I know where Hoyt is stashing beaucoup weapons and ammo 'n' shit. But the place was locked down tight.

Oh, this shit with you and Vaas and the rebels...Hoyt's started moving his men around, right? Hoyt's stash is in a WWII sub base that the Japanese built in a cave. Classic Indy, man. Total tourist trap before the collapse. There's only two ways in. The old supply tunnels that are locked from the inside by Hoyt's goombahs... and the sub channel.
So swimming through an underwater pipe? Sounds like fun.

Well, I’d send Bubbles III or Snowflake II, but chimps don't got a lot of body fat on 'em, so... they'd just drown. This is all you, man. Swim in, boat in, whatever, and when you get there, I'll tell you where to plant the explosives. Here's your C4. Good luck, man!
What? You give me explosives and you hug me? Are you kidding me?
Well it’s positive reinforcement, man. I believe in you, come on.
You can never have enough hugs, that’s a fact of life.
I gotta find that underwater pipe.
I knew you could do it, dude! OK, now plant the C4 on the support column.
You want me to bring the whole roof down?
Totally, man! And hey, I believe in you!
Man this place is crumbling. I wonder why Hoyt uses it.
After we patrol then we load weapons into the freight elevators for the daily shipment. Every day the same thing. And we never get breaks. Pay's lousy.
Beats digging ditches. Oh, wait, we do dig ditches.
Dude! There're boats in the water outside the pen. They'll sushify your ass. Take the elevator up and out.
Keep it pressed? You've got to be kidding me!
Dude, that sucks. So, like, what're you gonna do?
Okay, man, mellow. Look, the Japanese got to have built another way outta there, right? So look for that and then come see me on the barge, man. Peace!
Total Caruso moment, bro! This is so fucking awesome, you got no idea.

No big deal? No big deal?! Man, for the past ten years, shit has been stagnated. The old was the new. But there is more happening now than in the last decade, man! I decree this totally fuckin' awesome. You done good, monkey. You done real good, monkey.
Well, monkeys are a highly evolved species. Look. You earned this. The rebels said they are gonna tat me up because I helped them so much, and I owe you beaucoup for that.
Thanks, Hurk, I should warn you though, it's gonna hurt.

It’s cool man, I can take it. I want like a…I want like a dragon on me. No, no, no! A panther! No, no, no, no. You and me the Tat brothers fighting a panther. You got ‘em in a full nelson and I’m just going to town on him, just going to town.
Look, I don't think that's how it works. See ya around, Hurk. And lay off those monkeys, nothing good comes from huggin' chimps.
You ever ask a chimp that? 'Cause they'll have a different answer for ya, I swear to god.
There better be another way out of this place. What's this?
Seems to be a piece of a door code on it.
Hey, Szalinski, you shrunk the kids.
Wonder if they have Tetris? Someone D. I. R. slash P. that shit.
Something tells me there's one more piece of the door code nearby. It's cause I'm a Pisces, I know it.
Either this is a generator, or I'm going to be teleported to Rapture. Maybe I can start it.
Elevator down should work now, as long as I don't get electrocuted.
There's got to be another way around.
Bet this water would unclog my pores.
Welcome to the science fair, motherfuckers.
This should open the bay door.
Yes! Bet that leads to an exit.
Gotta get up to the elevator.
Guess I'm not flying to LA today.
Last one! Let's get out of here.
Huh. These guys were really into brand identity.
That logo is going to haunt my dreams.
So many dogs. I wonder if the logo drew them here. It compelled them, they couldn’t resist.
God. Smells like gas. Shooting in here will be suicide.
What the-- That looks like a missile silo.
Well, that was not as much fun as I thought it would be.
That's all I'm going to find in this room.
You know. I could use a portal right now.
Yes. Let's see if there're more.
Thank god there aren't any honey badgers down here.
What're they looking for? Military secrets? Are they trying to steal the logo?
Kids: don't drink on the job.
This looks like the way out.
Nice decor they have in here. Very nautical.
My daughter has been killed, murdered by her husband Senin. He hurt her…he hit her. I told her to leave him. I said that.
I know who you are. You are the one Dennis told us about. Mister Brody, my little girl, who I taught to walk and run and sing, is dead now.
Well...no, but it is his fault. She died of heartsickness and now he wants to know where she is buried so he can dig her up and take his ring back! Please...if you are good man, make him scared.
He is afraid of guns. Shoot at him, but do not hurt him. Make him run and tell him Rohana says to leave the grave alone! Please. Let my daughter be at peace.
I have a message from Rohana. Leave her daughter’s grave alone.
What's hers is mine by marriage.
No, don’t shoot me! Enough, enough!
I’ll leave the grave alone, I swear!
Please… please don't kill me… please!
We have so little in this life. You want me to give the dead a piece? That's insanity.
Did you see him? Did you tell him?
Thank you. Please take this. It's not much, but it's yours.
That is unfortunate. He is a victim now, and I did not want him to have that right. Take this. It's not much, but my girl can rest in peace now.
Can you come speak to me please!
You're the one the natives in the village are talking about. Bless you for talking to me.
Can I ask for your help? I am-- I'm ashamed, but I cannot speak to anyone here. There are no secrets among the members of my church.
Bless you.[Sorrowful laugh] I say that a lot, yes? My husband says I do. David. He is a good, God-fearing man, but...I am am worried he is committing adultery with another woman.
I do not wish to see it, but I want to know. Can you go? For me? Find him... see who he talks to? I know if it is true, that the Lord will forgive him.
That's David. Who's he talking to? Maybe I can get in closer.
It's easy for you. You have nothing to lose. I have Rebecca.
She's very religious. She won't understand. I don't want to hurt her.
You already did. She just doesn't know you did.
You think I have nothing to lose?
If you go back to her, then I'll be alone and she'll have you. But what do I know? I'm just being unfair.
Wh-What do you want? I won't pay you.
You need to man up and tell her.
Yes. Yes, I know. Thank you for giving me a chance to do it myself.
It doesn't matter. I've hurt two people I love. I don't deserve either one.
Jason, it is so good to see you again. Did you find my husband? Was he with another woman?
He's in love with a man.
A...man? Jalak? He's sleeping with Jalak! Jesus Christ. How could he do this to me? Please. You must not tell anyone. I'm going to cut it off.
I'm going to cut off his penis. Bless you. Goodbye.
You have a gun! You know how to use it?
Around here, is that even a question?

[Chuckles] I guess. Can you help us? The dogs in this part of the island are feral. Travel in packs. One of them's been acting really strange. Look, a few years back, my dog got infected with rabies. It was biting things, anything, breaking its teeth--foaming, barking, acting really crazy.
You think one of the dogs has rabies?
Yeah. I saw her yesterday. My dog had that same look.
Show me where to find her.
Thank you. But be careful. She's the leader of her pack. The other dogs are avoiding her, but her pack will be nearby.
I took care of your dog problem.
Thanks. Nobody likes killing dogs, but in this case, it's them or us. Did they bite you or scratch you?
No, but If I start foaming at the mouth, kill me quickly.
Uh...I'm going to take off now.
He has the tattoo of the Rakyat warriors. He will help us.
My darling. My jewel. How could she do this? Over a boy?
Aina, let me talk. Sir, my daughter Nadia run away with a boy. They want to... kill themselves.
They are young, foolish. They think life can never get better, so they leave.
Please... find Nadia. Bring her back. She is young. We looked everywhere.
No! Not everywhere. We didn't go to Bihar Rock! Please, sir. Can you go there? You will be faster.
Please...I just want to go home.
I don't want to leave. Not until they're all dead!
He tried to kill me... He said he wanted to run away, but when we got here, he started talking about dying together. Said we'd be together forever. He--he tried to shoot me.
He--he must have frightened the animals when he shot. They attacked him and I climbed.
Go home. Your mom and dad are freaking out.

I wanna to go home, I wanna go back to Samar. But my husband, he'll not let me. He says I'm his property. He...sells me to his friends. I try to run, but he's a bigshot with the privateers. Nobody will help me unless I pay.
You'll help me? Th-thank you. I know a captain who will take me home on his boat. He wants privateer blood diamonds. I overheard my husband telling his friends about where the privateers hide them.
Yeah. When do you leave for the boat?
I thought you were leaving the island.
I knew you'd fuck it up!
Shut up! I'll deal with you later.
You. You're dead. And we take the fucking diamonds.
I'm sorry. I didn't have a choice.
We were born to starve here on this island. We didn't have a choice. Just go.
A man has a right...to defend his family. A man...has a right...to fight. He has a right...to seek...[crying softly] vengeance.
Three men, against one… is not bravery. Three men with guns…
Just tell me where they are.
Three men, with my family's blood...on their shirts. A man will show you. He will show you.
Three against one to steal from children? That's pathetic.
This man's life is over. He can't get it back.
I think these belong to you.
Why won't anyone listen to me?

Please, nobody is listening to me. People are hurt, maybe dying. Last night. I thought it was thunder, but when I looked outside my window, I saw a plane fly right over the house. It was on fire. It was terrible.
Nobody saw it, nobody believes I saw it. But it crashed somewhere over there. People could be dying. They might be dead. Please. Go save them!
But this can't be the plane. It crashed years ago.
What are you doing here? I was just about to make dinner.
An old woman in the village was raving about a wrecked plane. Anyway, I'm sorry for bothering you.
This plane crashed ten years ago. Crushed a house. You can see a few remains outside.
You were in the village nearby?
Eh, nothing. Only that there's no old woman who lives there.
Hey, I know you! Saw you fuck up some pirates, my friend. Very, very impressive. I could use someone like you.
I'm serious. Look at my eyes. No blinking. That's how serious I am. Some of the villagers around here have gone missing, disappeared, vanished...poof.

There's this pool, supposed to be sacred. Ruins at the bottom, spooky scary stuff like a werewolf Bar Mitzvah. So villagers swim there and come back cleansed. But then three buddies went and never came back.
They say you came here by jumping out a plane? Bet someone told you not to do it, right? Huh?
Point taken. Okay. Where's the pool?
Time for some sharks and minnows.
It was a crocodile. But, I took care of it.
Fantastic! So a croc, huh? Must have been looking for food. Well, it happens, but that couldn’t have been easy peasy! Thank you!
Eh. You look like you wanna shoot something but got nothing to shoot.
That's got to be about the strangest hello I've ever heard.
Seto. I adopt lost Westerners and give them jobs. You should have seen the last four I helped-lah!
See where I'm standing? This as close as I get to the island. Not healthy in there. But if you're running around, you can grab me some things.
Where does the shooting come in?
Up to you-lah. When the pirates wrecked my boat, they stole some valuable things. I only want three of them back. I know these guys. I know where they are. I'll show you.
The first guy's always drunk. You can pull my poppa's wristwatch from his ass and he'll never wake up. But don't worry. It's not in his ass.

Fuckin' belter, pal. Now we go to the base an' hunt down the sleekit bastart.
That base sounds like our best bet of catching the bastard. Let's go.
Another base you say. All right, let's get a move on.
So we'll go to the base marked on the map. Sounds like a plan.
Another base huh? All right, let's get movin'.
Then we go to the base. Let us move.
If the captain is there, we must move quickly.
We have intruders! Cut the power to the elevator. And someone, fucking get Hoyt on the fucking line!
Get Hoyt on the phone and cut the power to the lift! We have intruders in the tunnels!
Does anyone know how many got in? We're fucking blind down here and I'm not calling Hoyt without a number!
Someone get on the fucking radio and give me an update! And call Hoyt!
The intruders are somewhere in the tunnels. Has anyone managed to phone out?
Has anyone been able to make a call out? We're only getting static over here.
Radio control. We need you to check the tower and get a call out to Hoyt. These bastards are after that guy he's been dealing with.
Radio control - get to the radio tower and see what's going on. There's a couple of fuckers going after that new partner of Hoyt's.
What a fuckin' bag of shite! They canny warn the captain. We need to destroy that fuckin' tower.
You cummin' the cunt? We have to ruin that fuckin' tower 'fore they can get the message out!
Shit. That asshole's gonna slip through our fingers again. Who's up for wreckin' that radio tower?
That call is gonna fuck our plan right up the ass. We can't let 'em fix that radio tower.
Fuck that. We need to get to that radio tower first. The old man can't know we're coming.
Oh, hell no. We need to get to that radio tower first and take it out. The captain can't know we're coming.
We must stop them from warning the captain. If we destroy the radio tower, we will stay one step ahead.
We cannot let them warn the captain. We go to the radio tower and destroy it. No phone, no warning.
We need to go up that.
We need to get up there.
That is not a good smell.
Hi, the car winch'll get the door movin'. Geeza hand and start the engine.
Hi, we can lift the door with the car winch. We just need to get it heated first.
The only thing that opens that door is the winch. Let's get the motor started.
Almost out. Now we just gotta use this winch thingamajig.
Looks like they got the door hooked up to that car winch. Can you get the engine started?
Weird. That car winch is rigged to open the door. Just need to get the car going first.
Interesting. They open the door with this car wire. We must begin the car running.
It appears they use the car wire to open door. We must start the car.
Hi, what the fuck are you doin'? Start the car!
You're a fouter! Do I have to start the fuckin' engine for you?
Hey, we gettin' this garage door opener started or what?
What, you don't know how to start a car?
The engine's gotta be running for us to use the winch.
We are losing time. Begin the car.
We do not have time to wait.
The men are destroying the car!
The fuck are you fuckin' doin'? Kill the bastarts!
Hi, the car's in fuckin' tatters, pal!
Pay attention! The car's gonna bite it!
Focus on the car for a sec, will ya?
Hey! The car's getting royally shot up here!
The winch is going! Eyes on the door!
The wire is started. Is time for the real fight.
Car's started. Geeza hand with the winch.
Hi, you. We can use the winch. You gonny do somethin' about that?
Car's finally running. Let's haul this door open.
Get on that winch. It's time to get out of this shitstop.
Sounds like it's heated up. We can flip on the winch now.
Car's heated. Grab the winch. Let's get this bitch up.
The car is ready. Now we can start the wire.
The car wire is ready to use.
Hi, dinnae dingy me, ya bas! We canny get out with the door closed!
Stop droolin', you glaekit eejit, and start the fuckin' winch!
Get the winch to open that door! I'm gettin' claustrophic here.
That winch ain't doing shit 'til you get it started.
Come on. Get that winch going!
The wire will pull open the door only if it is moving.
Hi, we've company! Fancy usin' grenades on the bastarts?
The eejits are queuin' up to die down there. Grenades'll do 'em proper, eh?
The dirtbags are on us like the last piece o' bacon at a Sunday buffet. Got grenades?
We got an assload of bad guys on the ground. Grab a grenade and get ready.
We got company. Grab some grenades. Let's see how they like the taste.
The dumbasses are lining up outside the gate. A few grenades should wipe 'em right out.
The fools are trying to attack, but they will not do well against grenades.
The enemy is approaching. We have the high ground. Use grenades.
You know you're supposed to aim those things, pal?
Might as well be a gynae, what with playin' with you fannies all day.
Easier than a chick on crutches.
You have to pull the pin before you throw them.
You should learn to throw grenade.
C'mon. I can see the tower from here.
Out of one hellhole and on our way to the next one.
Tower's ahead. Time to hit the road.
Come on. I can see the radio tower from here.
The way is forward. Let's continue.
Hi, here's the tower. Time to clam up the nosey bastarts.
Here's the tower. Pull up your breeches and let's get tae bombin' shite.
Come on. Let's get to wreckin' this thing.
There's the radio tower. Time to take this shit down.
There's the tower! Let's cut their comm for good.
There's the tower! We can't let them get to it!
There is the tower! We must destroy it!
There! The tower must be destroyed.
C'mon mate. That tower needs to go.
Here's a crackin' idea! Blow up the fuckin' tower.
We got bombs and a tower that needs to go. Two plus two, people.
Hey, get an explosive and set the damn thing.
We need to set an explosive on the tower.
The explosive will destroy the tower.
I don't like the looks of this. Hunker down. We can wait them out.
What just happened? Fuck, stay in here. We'll wait them out.
Hi, I'm not waitin' for nothin'. We can send a bomb down the lift. Redd 'em right out.
Here. Hoy a bomb down the lift. When the eejits run out, we'll finish 'em.
Call me crazy, but I think we can smoke 'em out if we get a bomb down the elevator.
I'd rather smoke 'em out than wait on my ass all day. We'll use the elevator.
Not a chance. If we can get a bomb down the elevator, we can just smoke them out.
Not gonna happen. We can put a bomb in the elevator and smoke 'em right out.
Send down the explosive in the lift. When it explodes, they will have nowhere to go.
We can use the lift to take explosive below. When there is smoke, they will come out.
Stop fartin' about and hoy a fuckin' bomb in the lift!
Hi, ye dinnae have to think 'boot it! Jus' do it!
C'mon, let's smoke these bastards out!
Pick up a bomb and put it in the fucking elevator.
Get a bomb in the elevator so we can smoke them out!
We need the explosive to be in the lift.
They cannot leave to tell the captain. We need to end them.
Bomb is in. Send it Down!
Got it. Grab the button, will ya?
The explosive is set. Lower the lift.
You want to get that lift, mate?
You gotta open the elevator, dumbass.
We must open the lift door.
Haha, the eejits fell for it! Now we can get every one of the cunts.
Hi, they're out! And here's a right opening for one more explosive.
Hey, it worked. Grab a bomb so we can get the rest of these cocksuckers.
Door's open! We get one more bomb up in there, we'll collapse the whole shebang.
They're coming out. Now's our chance to finish this fucking mess.
We got our opening. One more bomb in there, and we can be sure no one's left to talk.
The way is open. Get an explosive. We cannot leave survivors.
The way is open. Go inside and destroy what is left.
Haha, the eejits fell fer it! Now we can get destroy this shite and kill every one of the cunts!
Hi, they're out! And here's a right opening for one more explosive. Let's blow this place to fuckin' hell!
Hey, it worked. Grab a bomb so we can get rid of these cocksuckers for good!
Door's open! We get one more bomb up in there, we'll collapse the whole shebang!
They're coming out. Now's our chance to finish this fucking mess and get rid of this place for good!
We got our opening. One more bomb in there, and we can be sure no one's left to talk!
The way is open. Get an explosive. There can be no survivors!
The way is open. Go inside. We must destroy what is left!
Hi, we pannin' in the rest of this shite or no?
One more bomb is all I'm askin'.
Christ on a fuckin' breadstick. We wreckin' this place or not?
Once we plant the bomb, we can get out of here.
Hey, get a bomb and get your skinny white ass in that bunker!
We cannot leave until this is done.
We must be faster. The day will not wait.
Bomb's goin'! Get outta the building!
Bomb's planted! Get out of the bunker!
The bomb is set! We must leave!
As it goes, you're a long time dead. In the captain's case, I plan to make sure of it.
Not bad. Can we get fuckin' on with it, then?
Please tell me we held onto the frickin' map…
Yeah, now I bust a slavery ring. Fat lot of good that does me.
I know it doesn't change shit, but I'm glad to see that place go.
One step closer to ending this fuckin' freakshow.
Now, there is nowhere for the predatelj to hide. [trans: betrayer]
Ready to get your knuckles bloodied?
Don’t bother with the body bags.
They want peace? I want those fuckers in pieces!
It's time to reclaim our island!
Finish this, once and for all.
It is time to end our struggles.
Just let me focus on this, okay?
I just need to stay busy.
Know who your enemies are, Jason.
Hey! Save your bullets for the pirates!
I'll talk to you later. Thanks for saving me.
Look, just go, okay? I'll manage.
Go, Jason. I need time to... I just need time.
I think I'm gonna go get buzzed. Cya.
Hey, did you see those pills the Doc left? Wonder what they do?
Go play superman, dude... I'll hang here.
Wish I knew what to do.
I will go down with the ship! [Death rattle]
Do I look like an enemy to you? Don't answer that.
Does this look like the Munich Agreement to you? Do not stab me in the back!
You are making a big mistake.
Don't forget. Unlocking those radio towers gets me more stock. That's good for you.
Get those radio towers online. If you don’t, I can’t get new stock in from the remote villages, and trust me, they got some top notch gear you’re going to want.
Hey. Keep unlocking radio towers and I can get you more gear.
What would you like to buy?
Don't you have something to do?
Jason. I don't know what to say.
I hope we can talk about this later.
Things are starting to get interesting. Scuttlebutt says that Vaas is dead. Some kid named Jason Brody popped him. I'm impressed. Whoever takes Brody down will get some serious cred.
The pirates lost their psychotic leader. They'll be even more unpredictable now.
If they get out of line, we can take care of them, no problem. They're just thugs with guns.
It's an emergency, I need your car!
I really need this car, it's important.
I need to borrow your car.
Look, I really need these wheels.
Seriously, I need this car right now.
I need your car, it's an emergency.
I'm sorry, I gotta take your car.
I'm taking your car. I'll be careful with it!
Sorry, but I really need this car right now.
